email.subject: Welcome Ovilla at Legacy Square to the Fogelman Family—Let's Get Them Up to Speed Fast
email.body:
Hi [VP of Training and Development],

Congratulations on the acquisition of Ovilla in Dallas. We're excited to help bring the new team up to speed—and we can move fast. Let's schedule a call this week to confirm your opening timeline and next steps. Looking forward.

Best,
[Account Manager]

email.subject: Gilbert Onboarding + Compliance Opportunity for Camden Living
email.body:
Hi [Learning Technologies Specialist],

Congratulations on Camden Living's Gilbert property acquisition! We heard about the 320-unit community in Arizona—a significant expansion for your portfolio.

We'd like to help you onboard the Gilbert team quickly to PerformanceHQ. Since the November upgrade, your teams have achieved real-time compliance visibility and location-specific strategies that boost completion rates. The Gilbert team can realize the same benefits right away.

We'll also explore how Policies could standardize onboarding and compliance procedures across all 170+ communities.

Curious about timing and priorities? Happy to jump on a call.

Best,
[Your name]

email.subject: Congratulations on the San Diego Student Housing Project—A Quick Idea on Team Ramp-Up
email.body:
Hi [Director of Leasing and Marketing],

Congratulations on closing the San Diego State student housing development—305 beds, Class A, and a major win for Akara. We saw great ROI on Realync at Kenect Nashville and Sora (work-order reduction and tour speed), and we think there's an opportunity to build on that for your new team ramp-up in San Diego.

Student housing moves fast—high tour volume, quick conversions, and turnover means frequent resident FAQs. We'd love to explore how role-based Training (Learning Plans for leasing and maintenance speed) and Policies (resident self-service rules via our AI assistant) could help your team hit the ground running and serve residents faster.

Would you have 20 minutes in the next week to walk through the idea?

Best,
[Account Manager]
